children.label: Width
children.help_text: Specifies the maximum width of the tooltips.

children.name: horizontal
children.label: Horizontal
children.help_text: A positive value puts the shadow on the right side of the box, a negative value puts the shadow on the left side of the box

children.name: vertical
children.label: Vertical
children.help_text: The vertical offset of the shadow. A positive value puts the shadow below the box, a negative value puts the shadow above the box

children.name: blur
children.label: Blur
children.help_text: The blur radius. The higher the number, the more blurred the shadow will be

children.name: spread
children.label: Spread
children.help_text: The spread radius. A positive value increases the size of the shadow, a negative value decreases the size of the shadow

children.name: inset
children.label: Inset
children.help_text: Changes the shadow to an inner shadow

children.name: color
children.label: Color
children.help_text: The color of the shadow

children.name: layout
children.label: Layout
children.help_text:
Page: Sets a max-width at each responsive breakpoints

Full Width: 100% at all breakpoints

children.name: container_width
children.label: Container Width
children.help_text:
Maximum: 100% of the container

Wide: 83% of the container

Narrow: 66% of the container

Minimum: 50% of the container
